title: Moonshine hits a deadly blind spot in M.P.’s Sagar
description: A spurious liquor outbreak across several villages in Madhya Pradesh’s Sagar district has killed 16 people and left more  than 150 ill, with several victims suffering severe vision loss; more than 30 remain under treatment. Mehul Malpani traces the tragedy through the deaths linked to methyl alcohol poisoning, the police investigation into an alleged counterfeit liquor network and the harrowing accounts of victims’ families
